title: Monsters Among Us
premise: An alien escaped during an experiment breakout on the station.
finale: All three gates are online. The Void Gate opens onto the Final Boss.

events.name: Recon Squad finds logs
events.text: Recon pulled the breakout logs before the station lost power.

events.name: Supernatural / Sam
events.text: Sam heard the airlock cycle before anybody touched the controls.

events.name: Big monster on the loose
events.text: Something from the lab is loose. It dented the airlock from our side.

endings.name: Reset to station
endings.text: The airlock cycles again. Zulu calls the same breach.

endings.name: See
endings.text: Sam sees the experiment breakout play out on both sides of the gate.

endings.name: Release monsters
endings.text: The gate stays open, and the monsters spill back into the station.

endings.name: Stop / help alien self
endings.text: Sam reaches the alien self and stops the breach from repeating.

wings.name: Engineering
wings.synopsis: Rachel follows the power failure through the station systems and checks the robot logs against her scanner.

gate.text: I can read this gate with the vision scanner. The station AI insists it has never been powered.

rooms.text: I cut power to the scanner here. It kept drawing the same shape behind my shoulder.
A robot brought me its own fault report in my handwriting.
I pulled the system logs before the lights came back. Every restart begins with the lab alarm.

wings.name: Soldier
wings.synopsis: David tracks the escaped alien through the station and finds evidence it came back after the first sweep.

gate.text: Zulu swept this gate twice. The tracks on our second pass ran over our own.

rooms.text: The lab alarm sounded here after we cleared the room. This time it came through the floor.
It came up behind us while we checked the breach seal.
Zulu lost this section twice. On the second pass it already knew where we would take cover.

wings.name: Supernatural
wings.synopsis: Sam follows the repeating breach back to the Void Gate.

gate.text: I heard myself call the gate clear. I still had my helmet off.

rooms.text: I remember dying in this room. The flashlight battery is still warm in my hand.
My reflection kept moving when the station clock went back a second.
I heard the breach call again, with my own voice answering from beyond the gate.
